Qualification attempt — 2026-10-07 (local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007)

PHRF-11 remains review, not certified. The new four-shape, 60-trial audit has 24 data/voxel cases in two readout modes. ExactShape agrees with same-basis augmented QR to 3.884e-13; corrected eight-corner readout differs by up to 2.223 trial-amplitude units. ExactShape differs from the full-observation original-family trial solve by up to 0.00889. A sampled observed-design tail discrepancy reaches 3.485%, versus 0.000558% within-horizon basis error at that shape. These are exploratory counterexamples, not uniform bounds.

Pinned Gale already supplies ValidatedSvd/MatrixEnclosure and outward arithmetic; this audit executes finite-array spectral validation with positive lower bounds. Missing work is a complete family/convolution/whitening/tail enclosure and reference-neighborhood conditioning/error bound within the declared corrected-readout budget. Public CertifiedOriginalEquations still refuses. Preserve exact axis/normalization/query binding and charged work; do not replace this with a tolerance change or hidden exact fallback.

Final gates: dataset 76 JVM / 62 JS; targeted workflows 8 JVM / 8 JS; compiler warning-clean. Existing main-discovery warning only. No hosted CI, publication or epic closure. Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-qualification-20261007/README.md and certification-audit.md; 41 source/artifact hashes verified.
